_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Butterfly 2 (2024/2025 successor to the original Butterfly) — current-generation one-second-fold ultra-compact travel stroller. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Butterfly 2

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Butterfly 2 | Bugaboo Butterfly 2 car seat adapter | 400018003

specs._weightNote: 16 lb (7.3 kg) per Bugaboo official spec; some retailers list ~16.1 lb.
specs._dimsNote: Bugaboo official: unfolded 37.2 x 17.6 x 40.5 in; folded 17.6 x 9.6 x 21.8 in (IATA-compatible for overhead bins). Handlebar height 40.3 in.

brake.type: foot-operated single central parking pedal engaging both rear wheels (flip-flop friendly)

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 months to approx. 4 years in the seat; from birth with a compatible infant car seat + car seat adapter (400018003)

safety.standards: Not individually published as a numbered standard by Bugaboo; all strollers sold in the US must comply with 16 CFR 1227 (which incorporates ASTM F833). Bugaboo states its products are tested beyond industry safety standards.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; JPMA certification not confirmed/published for this model. Max child height not published by manufacturer (null).

specs.foldType: one-second, one-hand ultra-compact self-standing fold (IATA cabin-approved)
specs.recline: near-flat one-hand recline, approx. 30 to 143 degrees including a fully upright position
specs.tires: front 5.5 in swivel wheels / rear 6 in (larger than the original Butterfly); advanced 4-wheel suspension (tire material not published)

notes: CURRENT generation (2024/2025), successor to and replacing the original Butterfly. Same 16 lb one-second one-hand cabin fold (17.6 x 9.6 x 21.8 in) but with larger 5.5 in front wheels, taller/roomier canopy, near-flat recline and a fully-upright seat position. A prime light/compact city+travel candidate. Priced at $499 (on sale from $599 MSRP) at bugaboo.com DTC and Strolleria, both in stock. Clek Liing attaches via the Bugaboo Butterfly 2 car seat adapter 400018003 (adapter-400018003) — NOT interchangeable with the original Butterfly's 100045001 adapter.
